title: The Almost Yearbook
author: Marguerite Lockridge
blurb: Mirabel Voss, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
